title: security: RBAC v2 - KMS region pinning and audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Shah
description: Summary: This PR implements RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS key region pinning, improves audit logging for cross-region KMS usage, and adds migration tooling and tests to safely roll out the policy. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require explicit enforcement and observability of KMS key residency. Existing RBAC v2 allowed policy hints but did not prevent misconfiguration that could export keys or reference keys in different regions. This change closes that gap by adding an enforcement layer and richer audit events. What this PR does: 1) Adds a KMSRegionPinEnforcer to the RBAC v2 policy engine that validates request metadata against principal-scoped KMS residency constraints. 2) Exposes region pinning controls in the policy language (policy grammar additions included). 3) Emits structured audit log events for all KMS operations that include resolved key region, policy match id, and enforcement outcome. 4) Introduces a migration mode (audit-only -> enforce) toggled via feature flag and admin API to allow gradual rollout. 5) Adds integration and unit tests, and updates docs and Helm manifests. Checklist: - [x] Policy engine hook implemented - [x] Policy grammar extended and validated - [x] Audit log schema v2 created and mapped - [x] Migration toggle + admin API added - [x] Integration tests covering cross-region scenarios - [x] Backwards compatibility maintained in audit-only mode - [x] Docs updated and release notes drafted Design notes: The enforcer resolves KMS key ARNs to regions using the existing KMS resolver service. Policy evaluation now includes an optional "kms_region" attribute; if a policy contains a region pin constraint, the enforcer verifies it against the resolved key region. Audit events are emitted to the existing audit pipeline with a new event type "kms_region_enforcement" and include fields: key_arn, key_region, policy_id, principal_id, outcome (allowed/blocked), and reason. Migration strategy: default rollout is audit-only. Operators can flip the flag to "enforce" per-organization via the admin UI or the admin API (endpoint added: /admin/v1/security/rbac/v2/migration). We recommend a two-week audit window and review of all "blocked" events before enabling enforcement. Backwards compatibility: When feature flag is disabled or set to audit-only, enforcement is not applied and only audit events are emitted. Existing policies without region pins are unaffected. Testing: Added unit tests for policy parsing and enforcer logic, integration tests that spin up a lightweight KMS mock to simulate same-region and cross-region requests, and e2e smoke tests that validate Helm upgrade path. CI: initial CI run failed on lint (naming) and a flake in an integration test; fixes applied and full CI passed on rerun. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature-flag in staging for 72 hours, run audit queries, then enable in production in audit-only mode for two weeks before enforcement. Security review: linked_linear SEC-219 contains security review notes; addressed comments about timing attacks and info exposure by limiting region resolution to service-account-scoped calls and hashing audit-event identifiers. Additional notes: this PR avoids any secret material in logs, and key ARNs are redacted when emitting to external telemetry sinks. See files_changed for more details.

release_notes:
- Introduces RBAC v2 KMS region pinning enforcement (audit-only by default).
- New audit event type: kms_region_enforcement with structured fields for policy and resolution context.
- Admin API and Helm values to control migration from audit-only to enforcement.
- Backwards compatible: enforcement off by default; existing policies unchanged.
